import java.util.Scanner;

public class A_391_Variant2 {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        String s = sc.nextLine();
        int counter = 0;
        
        for (int idx = 0; idx < s.length(); ) {
            char current = s.charAt(idx);
            int length = 0;
            
            // Count the length of the current maximal sequence of identical nucleotides
            while (idx < s.length() && s.charAt(idx) == current) {
                length++;
                idx++;
            }
            
            // If the length is even, we need to insert one nucleotide to make it odd
            if (length % 2 == 0) {
                counter++;
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(counter);
    }
}
